scope: The two lists could both be right: 1 Chronicles 4:31 says the cities were theirs “unto the reign of David”, and a list of Simeon’s towns at that time need not be the list given at the distribution of the land. The Chronicles passage does not say this, and no verse reports the change; the record does not claim it. The Greek of Joshua 19:7 prints four towns and the Greek of 1 Chronicles 4:32 prints five, so the Greek agrees with its own Hebrew; no tag is proposed.
